newsitem.title: USA: Molecular challenges patents of 4 companies.
newsitem.headline: Molecular challenges patents of 4 companies.

text.p: Molecular Biosystems Inc said Friday it and marketing partner Mallinckrodt Inc filed a suit in federal court, challenging patents held by four competitors, including Sonus Pharmaceuticals Inc .

The company said it is challenging the validity of its competitors' patents on ultrasound contrast agents for medical imagining and is requesting a declaration that it and Mallinckrodt do not infringe the patents as the four companies have contended.

The company said the suit filed in the U.S. District court for the District of Columbia also names Norwegian pharmaceuticals group Nycomed ASA's subsidiary Nycomed Imaging AS of Princeton, N.J.; private Bracco International BV; and private ImaRx Pharmaceutical Corp of Tucson, Ariz., and its marketing partner, a joint venture between DuPont Co and Merck and Co Inc.
Molecular said it is requesting the court stops the companies from suing it and Mallinckrodt for infringement until a court or the U.S. Patent and Trademark Office determines patents' status.
The manufacturer of ultrasound contrast agents for medical imagining also said it petetioned the trademark office to re-examine the Sonus and Nycomed patents.
Company officials of Sonus, Nycomed and ImaRx were not immediately available for comment.
A spokeswoman for ImaRx's marketing partner, DuPont Merck Pharmaceutical Co in Wilmington, Del., was unavailable for comment.
